title: target-biology-uniprot — result payload schema
description: Result payload for target-biology-uniprot. Target-level (not indication-stratified). One evidence.json per gene; orchestrators surface this in the dossier's target-biology section.

uniprot_canonical_accession.description: UniProt canonical accession. v2.0 stores canonical only; isoform-aware in v2.x.

protein_existence.description: UniProt protein existence evidence, e.g. 'Evidence at protein level', 'Evidence at transcript level', 'Inferred from homology'.

sequence_length_aa.description: Canonical isoform length in amino acids.

is_membrane_protein.description: Convenience: any subcellular location includes 'membrane'. Drives surface-confidence flag for ADC / CAR-T / TCE modalities.

ptm_summary.description: Counts of common post-translational modification types.

function_summary.description: First sentence(s) of UniProt's FUNCTION field. Free-text; rendered into the dossier's target-biology section.

gene_family.description: UniProt-curated protein family classification, e.g. 'Small GTPase superfamily, Ras family' for KRAS.
